resources.string: Start recording from your phone shortcut, including after vivo asks you to unlock. Activate it again to stop and remind you in 10 minutes.

Select SpeakAlert in your phone’s screen-off quick action. Hold Volume Down and unlock if asked; recording starts automatically. While the recording screen is visible, press Volume Down to stop. If the screen is off, activate the shortcut again and unlock if asked, or use Stop in the recording notification.
Recording status and stop controls, including on the lock screen
Activate your shortcut again or tap Stop. Reminder: 10 minutes after stopping.
Recording or saving failed. Any completed recording is kept in the recordings inbox.
Recording saved. Open SpeakAlert to check the reminder schedule.
Unlock once and allow microphone and notification access to use quick recording.
